content.short: HumanDAO Academy offers educational modules and tutorials in Web3, awarding NFTs on completion.
content.description: HumanDAO Academy is an educational Web3 platform that rewards learners with NFTs for completing a range of learning modules and tutorials. These Soulbound Tokens serve as verifiable on-chain credentials, confirming module completion and potentially unlocking job opportunities for aspiring Web3 developers. By earning these tokens, participants build a persistent blockchain-backed record of their progress and skills, supporting their path into the Web3 ecosystem.

resources.title: Soulbound Tokens As Course Credit
resources.tldr: The DAO's own description of the academy: modules that mint a non-transferable token on completion, used as proof when applying for work.

resources.title: Education Aimed at Underserved Communities
resources.tldr: Free courses paired with grants and income routes, on the view that access is the barrier rather than interest.
